logp.method_description: Lipophilicity was expressed according to the distribution coefficient (logPo/w). The lipophilicity of complexes 1–3 was experimentally determined by the “shake-flask” method as previously described [29,4]. Briefly, an aliquot of a stock solution of each complex in octanol (saturated with10 mM phosphate buffer for 24 h) was added to the same volume of 10 mM phosphate buffer (pH = 7.4, saturated with octanol), and the mixture was shaken at 298 K and equilibrated for 5 h. The concentrations of Fe in both aqueous phase and octanol phase were determined by icap 6300 ICP-MS and used to calculate the [Fe]o/[Fe]w ratio.
